body: Yeat says he’s fully sober now and keeping his daily routine simple Congrats to Yeat The rapper shared that his days mostly consist of waking up, eating, working out and making music, with trips to the store rounding out the list. He described those everyday activities as pretty much all he does. Between time in the studio and staying active, Yeat’s update gives fans a glimpse into his life away from the stage. Much love to him as he continues his sobriety journey.

Yeat says he’s fully sober now and keeping his daily routine simple 🙏❤️

Congrats to Yeat 💯

The rapper shared that his days mostly consist of waking up, eating, working out and making music, with trips to the store rounding out the list. He described those everyday activities as pretty much all he does.

Between time in the studio and staying active, Yeat’s update gives fans a glimpse into his life away from the stage. Much love to him as he continues his sobriety journey 👏
